title: Motion-aware elevation and responsive corner system for controls and grids
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a motion-sensitive elevation token set and a responsive corner-radius system that adapts across breakpoints and density modes. Goal is to improve perceived hierarchy in interactive surfaces (buttons, pills, inputs) and tabular rows while ensuring accessible contrast, consistent shadow performance across GPUs, and a smooth UX during hover/focus/press animations.
motivation: Current elevation tokens are static and don't reflect interactive motion states; corner radii are inconsistent across components and breakpoints causing visual noise in dense grids and mobile. This causes unclear affordances on hover/press and makes tables with selectable rows feel visually inconsistent with controls.
acceptance_criteria: Design token spec published in the design token registry with names: elevation.motion.xs | elevation.motion.sm | elevation.static.xs etc.
Corner radius scale defined as radius.condensed, radius.cozy, radius.relaxed and mapped to component variants and breakpoints.
Figma component library updated and annotated with motion timelines and easing curves.
Dev implementation PR merged with visual-diff tests demonstrating parity across supported browsers and density modes.
Accessibility audit confirms no contrast regressions and motion preferences respected (prefers-reduced-motion).
Migration guide exists mapping old token names to new tokens and listing components needing manual updates.
Console and runtime token exposure documented for teams using Redwood Console token overrides.
tasks: Audit existing components for current elevation and radius usage (buttons, inputs, selectable table rows, chips).
Define motion-aware elevation token ramp (values and shadow geometry) and produce Figma styles and CSS token fallbacks.
Design responsive radius scale and document mapping to breakpoints and density modes.
Prototype hover/focus/press transitions and get design critique sign-off.
Create migration guide and automated codemod patterns where feasible.
Open engineering ticket to implement tokens and update core components (ENG-43112).
Run visual regression tests and iterate on shadow intensities for light/dark themes.
Coordinate release notes and rollout plan with PM and Platform Engineering.
migration_notes: Map old token elevation.depth-1 -> elevation.static.xs and elevation.hover-1 -> elevation.motion.sm.
Provide codemod to replace legacy radius variables with radius.condensed/radius.cozy according to component density comment markers.
Flag custom component overrides and create checklist for manual review (data-grid, third-party libs).
qa_checks: Verify visual diff for primary components across themes and density modes.
Confirm prefers-reduced-motion disables transition and uses static elevation fallback.
Keyboard focus state shows elevation and outline per spec and passes WCAG keyboard focus visibility checks.
Performance: shadow shaders should not regress 95th percentile frame times for interactive lists.
Confirm token names are exported in the design token package and documented in README.
risks: Shadows can be GPU-costly on lower-end devices; will provide CSS fallbacks with simplified box-shadows for constrained devices.
Automated codemod may miss bespoke component stylings; expect manual follow-ups.
Dark theme shadow tuning may require additional contrast balancing for readability on elevated surfaces.
